---
title: UATAQ Status Dashboard
---

```{r Setup}
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly, warn.conflicts = F)
library(tidyverse)
data <- readRDS('../_data.rds')
colors <- c('#323031', '#413C58', '#6B818C', '#3DCCC7', '#76F7BF',
            '#C4B7CB', '#1BB065', '#BCE784', '#F9E332', '#E49820',
            '#FF8360', '#E1401D')
rmse <- function(e) sqrt(mean(e^2, na.rm = T))
# Species names and units from column names, e.g. 'PM2.5_ugm3', 'CO2d_ppm'
species_order <- c('CO2', 'CH4', 'H2O', 'O3', 'NO', 'NO2', 'CO', 'PM2.5', 'BC6')  # others follow
species_of <- function(var) sub('d$', '', sub('_.*', '', var))  # 'CO2d_ppm' -> 'CO2'
species_rank <- function(sp) {
  ifelse(sp %in% species_order, match(sp, species_order), length(species_order) + 1)
}
species_label <- function(sp) gsub('([A-Za-z])([0-9.]+)', '\\1<sub>\\2</sub>', sp)  # 'H2O' -> 'H<sub>2</sub>O'
units_of <- function(var) {
  u <- sub('^[^_]+_', '', var)                              # 'PM2.5_ugm3' -> 'ugm3'
  ifelse(u == 'ugm3', 'ug/m3', ifelse(u == 'ngm3', 'ng/m3', u))
}

# One color per site for every plot on the page. plotly spreads `colors`
# over the sites in each plot, so the same site came out a different color in
# plots with different sites. The GHG sites keep the colors that spread gives
# them across all GHG sites; sites with only air quality instruments get
# colors from outside that palette.
# Sites on the status grid: the top row is as tall as the grid (about 33 px a
# site plus the header), and the diel beside it takes the same height
n_grid_sites <- length(unique(c(data$qaqc$stid, data$instruments$last_seen$stid)))
site_colors <- local({
  ghg_sites <- sort(unique(data$qaqc$stid))
  ghg <- setNames(scales::col_factor(colors, domain = ghg_sites)(ghg_sites), ghg_sites)
  others <- setdiff(sort(unique(data$instruments$last_seen$stid)), ghg_sites)
  extra <- c('#7570B3', '#E7298A', '#1B9E77', '#A6761D')  # not in `colors`
  c(ghg, setNames(rep(extra, length.out = length(others)), others))
})
```

Row {data-height=`r 75 + 33 * n_grid_sites`}

### Average Diel Cycle (10-day, Mountain Time) <span style="float:right;"><a href="/s/diagnostics/"><i class="fa fa-bar-chart"></i> Timeseries Diagnostics</a></span> {data-width=750}
```{r Diel Cycle}
# One plot, one species at a time, picked with the buttons above it: CO2,
# CH4, H2O, then every species the other instruments measure (O3, NO, NO2, CO,
# PM2.5, ...). All from the qaqc data (only the Calibrations tabs use
# calibrated data), atmosphere rows passing QAQC, as in the species tabs.
hour_of <- function(t) as.integer(format(t, tz = 'America/Denver', format = '%H'))
ghg_air <- function(id) {
  data$qaqc %>% filter(.data[[id]] == -10, QAQC_Flag >= 0)
}
diel <- bind_rows(
  ghg_air('ID_CO2') %>%
    transmute(stid, variable = 'CO2d_ppm', hour = hour_of(Time_UTC), value = CO2d_ppm),
  ghg_air('ID_CH4') %>%
    transmute(stid, variable = 'CH4d_ppm', hour = hour_of(Time_UTC), value = CH4d_ppm),
  ghg_air('ID_CO2') %>%
    transmute(stid, variable = 'H2O_ppm', hour = hour_of(Time_UTC), value = H2O_ppm),
  # Any failure here leaves the greenhouse gases alone
  tryCatch({
    inst <- data$instruments
    aq <- unique(inst$last_seen$instrument[!inst$last_seen$is_ghg])
    species <- inst$checks %>%
      filter(is_species, instrument %in% aq) %>%
      distinct(instrument, variable)
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(species)), function(i) {
      pd <- inst$obs[[species$instrument[i]]]
      v <- species$variable[i]
      if (is.null(pd) || !v %in% names(pd)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(stid = pd$stid, variable = v, hour = hour_of(pd$Time_UTC),
                 value = pd[[v]])
    }))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(variable, stid, hour) %>%
  summarize(avg = mean(value), .groups = 'drop')

diel_vars <- unique(diel$variable)
diel_vars <- diel_vars[order(species_rank(species_of(diel_vars)), diel_vars)]
diel_title <- function(v) paste0(species_of(v), ' (', units_of(v), ')')

# One trace per species and site; the buttons show one species' traces
p <- plot_ly()
trace_var <- c()
for (v in diel_vars) {
  for (st in sort(unique(diel$stid[diel$variable == v]))) {
    d <- diel[diel$variable == v & diel$stid == st, ]
    p <- add_trace(p, x = d$hour, y = d$avg, name = st,
                   type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers',
                   visible = v == diel_vars[1],
                   line = list(color = site_colors[[st]]),
                   marker = list(color = site_colors[[st]], size = 5))
    trace_var <- c(trace_var, v)
  }
}
buttons <- lapply(diel_vars, function(v) {
  list(label = species_label(species_of(v)), method = 'update',
       args = list(list(visible = as.list(trace_var == v)),
                   list(yaxis = list(title = diel_title(v), autorange = TRUE))))
})
p %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = NA, tickvals = seq(0, 21, 3),
                      ticksuffix = ':00'),
         yaxis = list(title = diel_title(diel_vars[1])),
         # sites of the species shown, in a row under the plot
         showlegend = T, margin = list(t = 50, b = 10),
         legend = list(orientation = 'h', x = 0.5, xanchor = 'center',
                       y = -0.1, yanchor = 'top'),
         updatemenus = list(list(type = 'buttons', direction = 'right',
                                 buttons = buttons, showactive = TRUE,
                                 x = 0, xanchor = 'left', y = 1.02, yanchor = 'bottom',
                                 pad = list(r = 4, t = 0), bgcolor = '#f5f5f5',
                                 bordercolor = '#ddd', font = list(size = 12))))
```

### Network Diagnostics (1-day) <span class="info-tip" tabindex="0"><i class="fa fa-info-circle"></i><span class="info-pop">Latest hourly value of each species, passing QAQC or not.<br><span style="color: white; background-color: #FFB20F; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 5px;">orange</span> under 90% of the past day passing QAQC, or noisy (ptp over its limit).<br><span style="color: white; background-color: #ED254E; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 5px;">red</span> silent over 2 hours, under 50% passing, or reference error over its limit.<br>Hover a cell for last seen, flags, ptp and err.</span></span> <span style="float:right;"><a href="https://github.com/uataq/data-pipeline/blob/main/QAQC_Flags.md#qaqc-flags"><i class="fa fa-bars"></i> QAQC Definitions</a></span> {data-width=850}
```{r Network Diagnostics}
# A grid of every site (rows) and every species it measures (columns), for the
# greenhouse gas and air quality instruments alike. Like the map, the columns
# come from the data: nothing here lists sites or instruments. Each cell shows
# the latest hourly value, marked
#   red    instrument silent for over 2 hours, under 50% of the past day's rows
#          passing QAQC, or reference error over its limit
#   orange under 90% of rows passing, or point-to-point noise over its limit
# Hovering a cell gives last seen, % passing, the flags raised, ptp and err.
pd_ref <- data$qaqc %>%
  filter(Time_UTC >= Sys.time() - 86400 * 1,
         ID_CO2 > 0)
pd_ref_error <- pd_ref %>%
  group_by(stid) %>%
  summarize(`co2 err` = sd(CO2d_ppm - ID_CO2, na.rm = T),
            `ch4 err` = sd(CH4d_ppm - ID_CH4, na.rm = T))

inst_short_name <- function(inst) {
  name <- data$instruments$checks$name[match(inst, data$instruments$checks$instrument)]
  sub('^Teledyne ', '', name)
}
day_ago <- Sys.time() - 86400
# 431, 27.7, 2.10, 0.03; '-' when there is no passing data
format_value <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return('-')
  sprintf(paste0('%.', ifelse(abs(x) >= 100, 0, ifelse(abs(x) >= 10, 1, 2)), 'f'), x)
}
# Flags other than 0 (pass) and -1 (removed by hand), e.g. "-81 (71%)"
flag_text <- function(flag, pct) {
  keep <- !flag %in% c(0, -1)
  paste(sprintf('%d (%.1f%%)', flag[keep], pct[keep])[order(-pct[keep])],
        collapse = ', ')
}

# Greenhouse gases: limits are the ones the old table used
ghg_limits <- tribble(
  ~species, ~variable,  ~err_limit, ~ptp_limit,
  'CO2',    'CO2d_ppm', 3,          2,
  'CH4',    'CH4d_ppm', 0.03,       0.01
)
# Each site's greenhouse gas analyzer, for the hover text
ghg_names <- tryCatch(
  as.data.frame(data$instruments$last_seen) %>%
    filter(is_ghg) %>%
    mutate(name = data$instruments$checks$name[match(instrument, data$instruments$checks$instrument)]) %>%
    group_by(stid) %>%
    summarize(instrument = paste(unique(name), collapse = ', ')),
  error = function(e) data.frame(stid = character(), instrument = character()))
ghg_cells <- function() {
  recent <- data$qaqc %>% filter(ID_CO2 != -99, Time_UTC > day_ago)
  site <- data$qaqc %>%
    group_by(stid) %>%
    summarize(last_seen = max(Time_UTC))
  qaqc <- recent %>%
    count(stid, QAQC_Flag) %>%
    group_by(stid) %>%
    mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    summarize(passing = sum(pct[QAQC_Flag >= 0]), flags = flag_text(QAQC_Flag, pct))
  atmosphere <- recent %>% filter(ID_CO2 == -10)
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(ghg_limits)), function(i) {
    v <- ghg_limits$variable[i]
    atmosphere %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
      group_by(stid) %>%
      summarize(ptp = mean(abs(diff(.data[[v]]))),
                latest = mean(.data[[v]][Time_UTC > max(Time_UTC) - 3600])) %>%
      mutate(species = ghg_limits$species[i], units = units_of(v),
             err_limit = ghg_limits$err_limit[i], ptp_limit = ghg_limits$ptp_limit[i])
  })) %>%
    left_join(pd_ref_error %>%
                pivot_longer(-stid, names_to = 'species', values_to = 'err') %>%
                mutate(species = toupper(sub(' err', '', species))),
              by = c('stid', 'species')) %>%
    left_join(site, by = 'stid') %>%
    left_join(qaqc, by = 'stid') %>%
    left_join(ghg_names, by = 'stid')
}

aq_cells <- function() {
  aq <- data$instruments  # only its air quality instruments are used here
  qaqc <- as.data.frame(aq$flags) %>%
    group_by(stid, instrument) %>%
    mutate(pct = 100 * N / sum(N)) %>%
    summarize(passing = sum(pct[QAQC_Flag >= 0]), flags = flag_text(QAQC_Flag, pct),
              .groups = 'drop')
  species <- aq$checks %>%
    filter(is_species) %>%
    distinct(instrument, variable)
  as.data.frame(aq$last_seen) %>%
    filter(!is_ghg) %>%
    select(-is_ghg) %>%
    inner_join(species, by = 'instrument', relationship = 'many-to-many') %>%
    left_join(qaqc, by = c('stid', 'instrument')) %>%
    left_join(as.data.frame(aq$species_day), by = c('stid', 'instrument', 'variable')) %>%
    mutate(species = species_of(variable), units = units_of(variable),
           err = NA_real_, err_limit = NA_real_, ptp_limit = NA_real_,
           instrument = data$instruments$checks$name[match(instrument, data$instruments$checks$instrument)]) %>%
    select(-variable)
}

badge <- function(text, status) {
  colors <- c(NA, '#FFB20F', '#ED254E')
  ifelse(status == 1,
         paste0('<span style="margin: 0 5px;">', text, '</span>'),
         paste0('<span style="color: white; background-color: ', colors[status],
                '; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-block;">',
                text, '</span>'))
}

# How a number compares with its limit: 1 fine, 2 orange, 3 red
over <- function(x, limit, status) ifelse(!is.na(x) & !is.na(limit) & x > limit, status, 1)
limit_text <- function(limit) ifelse(is.na(limit), '', paste0(' <span style="color: #999;">(limit ', limit, ')</span>'))

cells <- bind_rows(
  ghg_cells(),
  tryCatch(aq_cells(), error = function(e) NULL)  # never break the GHG part
) %>%
  mutate(
    passing = coalesce(passing, 0),
    status = case_when(
      last_seen < Sys.time() - 2 * 3600 | passing < 50 |
        (!is.na(err) & !is.na(err_limit) & err > err_limit) ~ 3,
      passing < 90 | (!is.na(ptp) & !is.na(ptp_limit) & ptp > ptp_limit) ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 1),
    seen_old = last_seen < Sys.time() - 2 * 3600,
    tip = paste0(
      '<b>', stid, '</b> &middot; ', coalesce(instrument, 'greenhouse gas analyzer'),
      '<br>last seen ', badge(format(last_seen, tz = 'America/Denver', '%b %d %H:%M %Z'),
                              ifelse(seen_old, 3, 1)),
      '<br>', badge(sprintf('%.1f%%', passing),
                    ifelse(passing < 50, 3, ifelse(passing < 90, 2, 1))),
      ' of rows passing QAQC (past day)',
      ifelse(nchar(coalesce(flags, '')) > 0, paste0('<br>flags: ', flags), ''),
      ifelse(is.na(ptp), '', paste0('<br>ptp ', badge(signif(ptp, 2), over(ptp, ptp_limit, 2)),
                                    limit_text(ptp_limit))),
      ifelse(is.na(err), '', paste0('<br>err ', badge(signif(err, 2), over(err, err_limit, 3)),
                                    limit_text(err_limit))))
  ) %>%
  # A species measured twice at one site: the worse status, both in the hover
  group_by(stid, species, units) %>%
  summarize(value = format_value(latest[!is.na(latest)][1]),
            tip = paste(tip, collapse = '<hr style="margin: 6px 0;">'),
            status = max(status),
            last_seen = min(last_seen),
            .groups = 'drop')

grid_species <- unique(cells$species)
grid_species <- grid_species[order(species_rank(grid_species), grid_species)]
grid_units <- cells$units[match(grid_species, cells$species)]
sites <- sort(unique(cells$stid))
site_seen <- cells %>% group_by(stid) %>% summarize(last_seen = min(last_seen))

# Times: '21:15' today, 'Nov 04 21:15' before (Mountain Time)
short_time <- function(t) {
  today_mt <- format(Sys.time(), tz = 'America/Denver', '%Y-%m-%d')
  ifelse(format(t, tz = 'America/Denver', '%Y-%m-%d') == today_mt,
         format(t, tz = 'America/Denver', '%H:%M'),
         format(t, tz = 'America/Denver', '%b %d %H:%M'))
}
unit_line <- function(u) paste0('<br><span class="grid-unit">', u, '</span>')
header <- paste0('<th style="text-align: left;">stid</th>',
                 '<th style="text-align: right;">last seen', unit_line('MT'), '</th>',
                 paste0('<th style="text-align: center;">', species_label(grid_species),
                        unit_line(grid_units), '</th>', collapse = ''))
rows <- sapply(sites, function(s) {
  seen <- site_seen$last_seen[site_seen$stid == s]
  tds <- sapply(grid_species, function(sp) {
    cell <- cells[cells$stid == s & cells$species == sp, ]
    if (nrow(cell) == 0) return('<td style="text-align: center; color: #ccc;">&middot;</td>')
    paste0('<td style="text-align: center;"><span class="grid-tip">',
           badge(cell$value, cell$status),
           '<span class="grid-pop">', cell$tip, '</span></span></td>')
  })
  paste0('<tr><td>', s, '</td>',
         '<td style="text-align: right;">',
         badge(short_time(seen), ifelse(seen < Sys.time() - 2 * 3600, 3, 1)),
         '</td>', paste(tds, collapse = ''), '</tr>')
})
# Hover pop-up for each cell: a hidden box in the cell, shown by CSS
tip_css <- '<style>
.grid-tip { position: relative; cursor: default; }
.grid-pop {
  display: none; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 130%; z-index: 1000;
  white-space: nowrap; text-align: left; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7;
  background: white; color: #333; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 6px 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.grid-tip:hover .grid-pop { display: block; }
.grid-table th, .grid-table td { white-space: nowrap; }
.grid-table th { vertical-align: bottom !important; line-height: 1.2; }
.grid-unit { font-weight: normal; color: #999; font-size: 80%; }
/* the (i) next to the title: what the colors mean, on hover or tap */
.info-tip { position: relative; color: #999; cursor: help; margin-left: 4px; outline: none; }
.info-pop {
  display: none; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 150%; z-index: 1000;
  width: 360px; white-space: normal; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8;
  background: white; color: #333; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 8px 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.info-tip:hover .info-pop, .info-tip:focus .info-pop { display: block; }
.chart-title { overflow: visible !important; }
</style>'
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  tip_css,
  '<table class="table table-condensed grid-table"><thead><tr>', header, '</tr></thead><tbody>',
  paste(rows, collapse = ''), '</tbody></table>'
))
```

### GHG Diagnostics (10-day)

```{r GHG Diagnostics}
pd_h2o <- data$qaqc %>%
  filter(ID_CO2 == -10) %>%
  group_by(Time_UTC = as.POSIXct(trunc(Time_UTC, 'hours')),
           stid) %>%
  summarize(H2O_ppm_avg = mean(H2O_ppm, na.rm = T),
            H2O_ppm_sd = sd(H2O_ppm, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup()
attributes(pd_h2o$Time_UTC)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
pd_flow <- data$qaqc %>%
  group_by(Time_UTC = as.POSIXct(trunc(Time_UTC, 'hours')),
           stid) %>%
  summarize_all(funs(mean(., na.rm = T))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Time_UTC, QAQC_Flag, stid, ID_CO2, Flow_mLmin, Cavity_P_torr) %>%
  gather(key, value, -Time_UTC, -QAQC_Flag, -stid, -ID_CO2) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(ideal = ifelse(key == 'Flow_mLmin', 400, 140),
         flow_error = 100 * (value - ideal) / ideal)
attributes(pd_flow$Time_UTC)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
subplot(
  plot_ly(pd_h2o, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~H2O_ppm_avg, color = ~stid,
          type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines+markers', colors = site_colors) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
           yaxis = list(title = 'H2O (ppm)'),
           showlegend = F),
  plot_ly(filter(pd_flow, ID_CO2 == -10),
          x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~flow_error, color = ~stid,
          type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
           yaxis = list(title = 'Atmosphere\n% Flow Error'),
           showlegend = F),
  plot_ly(filter(pd_flow, ID_CO2 > 0),
          x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~flow_error, color = ~stid,
          type = 'scattergl', mode = 'markers', colors = site_colors,
          marker = list(size = 15,
                        line = list(color = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, .3)',
                                    width = 2),
                        opacity = 0.8)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = 'Mountain Time'),
           yaxis = list(title = 'References\n% Flow Error'),
           showlegend = F),
  heights = c(0.5, 0.25, 0.25), nrows = 3, shareX = T, titleX = T, titleY = T)
```

### CO<sub>2</sub> Calibrations

```{r CO2 Calibrations}
pd <- data$calibrated %>%
  filter(ID_CO2 == -10) %>%
  group_by(Time_UTC = as.POSIXct(trunc(Time_UTC, 'hours')),
           stid) %>%
  summarize_all(funs(mean(., na.rm = T))) %>%
  ungroup()
attributes(pd$Time_UTC)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
pd_ref_fits <- pd_ref %>%
  filter(!is.na(CO2d_ppm), !is.na(ID_CO2)) %>%
  group_by(stid) %>%
  do({
    # do() evaluates once on an empty frame when no rows survive the filters;
    # keep the columns so downstream add_segments() can still reference them
    if (nrow(.) < 2) {
      data.frame(stid = character(), x = numeric(), xend = numeric(),
                 y = numeric(), yend = numeric())
    } else {
      mod <- lm(CO2d_ppm ~ ID_CO2, data = .)
      data.frame(
        stid = .$stid[1],
        x = min(.$ID_CO2),
        xend = max(.$ID_CO2),
        y = predict(mod, data.frame(ID_CO2 = min(.$ID_CO2))),
        yend = predict(mod, data.frame(ID_CO2 = max(.$ID_CO2)))
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
subplot(
  subplot(
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CO2d_ppm_cal, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines+markers', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'CO2 (ppm)'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CO2d_rmse, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'RMSE'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~abs(CO2d_ppm_cal - CO2d_ppm_raw), color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Correction'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CO2d_m, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'm'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CO2d_b, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'b'),
             showlegend = F),
    nrows = 5, heights = c(0.4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15), 
    shareX = T, titleX = T, titleY = T
  ),
  subplot(
    plot_ly(pd_ref, x = ~ID_CO2, y = ~CO2d_ppm, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'markers', colors = site_colors) %>%
      add_segments(x = min(pd_ref$CO2d_ppm), xend = max(pd_ref$CO2d_ppm), 
                   y = min(pd_ref$CO2d_ppm), yend = max(pd_ref$CO2d_ppm), 
                   color = I('black'), opacity = 0.1, inherit = F, showlegend = F) %>%
      add_segments(x = ~x, xend = ~xend, y = ~y, yend = ~yend, data = pd_ref_fits,
                   color = ~stid, colors = site_colors,
                   inherit = F, opacity = 0.2) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = 'Known'),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Measured'),
             showlegend = F),
    pd_ref_error %>%
      plot_ly(x = ~stid, y = ~`co2 err`, color = ~stid, type = 'bar',
              colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Reference Error'),
             showlegend = F),
    nrows = 2,
    margin = 0.08, titleX = T, titleY = T, heights = c(0.75, 0.25)
  ),
  margin = 0.03, titleX = T, titleY = T, widths = c(0.6, 0.4)
)
```

### CH<sub>4</sub> Calibrations
```{r CH4 Calibrations}
pd_ref <- filter(pd_ref, !is.na(CH4d_ppm), !is.na(ID_CH4))
pd_ref_error <- filter(pd_ref_error, !is.na(`ch4 err`))
pd_ref_fits <- pd_ref %>%
  group_by(stid) %>%
  do({
    # do() evaluates once on an empty frame when no rows survive the filters;
    # keep the columns so downstream add_segments() can still reference them
    if (nrow(.) < 2) {
      data.frame(stid = character(), x = numeric(), xend = numeric(),
                 y = numeric(), yend = numeric())
    } else {
      mod <- lm(CH4d_ppm ~ ID_CH4, data = .)
      data.frame(
        stid = .$stid[1],
        x = min(.$ID_CH4),
        xend = max(.$ID_CH4),
        y = predict(mod, data.frame(ID_CH4 = min(.$ID_CH4))),
        yend = predict(mod, data.frame(ID_CH4 = max(.$ID_CH4)))
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
subplot(
  subplot(
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CH4d_ppm_cal, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines+markers', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'CH4 (ppm)'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CH4d_rmse, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'RMSE'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~abs(CH4d_ppm_cal - CH4d_ppm_raw), color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Correction'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CH4d_m, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'm'),
             showlegend = F),
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~Time_UTC, y = ~CH4d_b, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines', colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'b'),
             showlegend = F),
    nrows = 5, heights = c(0.4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15), 
    shareX = T, titleX = T, titleY = T
  ),
  subplot(
    plot_ly(pd_ref, x = ~ID_CH4, y = ~CH4d_ppm, color = ~stid,
            type = 'scattergl', mode = 'markers', colors = site_colors) %>%
      add_segments(x = min(pd_ref$CH4d_ppm), xend = max(pd_ref$CH4d_ppm), 
                   y = min(pd_ref$CH4d_ppm), yend = max(pd_ref$CH4d_ppm), 
                   color = I('black'), opacity = 0.1, inherit = F, showlegend = F) %>%
      add_segments(x = ~x, xend = ~xend, y = ~y, yend = ~yend, data = pd_ref_fits,
                   color = ~stid, colors = site_colors,
                   inherit = F, opacity = 0.2) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = 'Known'),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Measured'),
             showlegend = F),
    pd_ref_error %>%
      plot_ly(x = ~stid, y = ~`ch4 err`, color = ~stid, type = 'bar',
              colors = site_colors) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
             yaxis = list(title = 'Reference Error'),
             showlegend = F),
    nrows = 2,
    margin = 0.08, titleX = T, titleY = T, heights = c(0.75, 0.25)
  ),
  margin = 0.03, titleX = T, titleY = T, widths = c(0.6, 0.4)
)
```

```{r Species Panels}
# One tab per species (CO2 / CH4, O3, NO / NO2, ...), styled like GHG
# Diagnostics, for the greenhouse gas and air quality instruments alike.
# Like the map, nothing here names a site or an instrument: the
# tabs come from the species the instruments with recent data measure (the
# "measurement out of range" checks in pipeline/QAQC_Flags.md), and
# instruments that share a species share a tab (T200 and T500u -> NO / NO2).
# Each tab: hourly means of the species (passing rows only), then for each
# instrument model a heatmap strip of the variables the pipeline checks it on
# (limits from QAQC_Flags.md); hovering shows the real value.
# With no instrument data, or any error here, no tabs are added
inst_tabs <- tryCatch({
  inst_checks <- data$instruments$checks[data$instruments$checks$instrument %in% names(data$instruments$obs), ]
  inst_species <- inst_checks %>%
    filter(is_species) %>%
    distinct(instrument, variable) %>%
    mutate(species = species_of(variable))

  # Group species into tabs: instruments sharing a species share a tab
  groups <- list()
  for (inst in unique(inst_species$instrument)) {
    sp <- inst_species$species[inst_species$instrument == inst]
    hit <- which(vapply(groups, function(g) any(sp %in% g), logical(1)))
    others <- if (length(hit) > 0) groups[-hit] else groups
    groups <- c(others, list(unique(c(sp, unlist(groups[hit])))))
  }
  groups <- lapply(groups, function(g) g[order(species_rank(g), g)])
  groups <- groups[order(sapply(groups, function(g) min(species_rank(g))),
                         sapply(groups, `[`, 1))]
  lapply(groups, function(g) {
    list(label = paste(species_label(g), collapse = ' / '),
         instruments = unique(inst_species$instrument[inst_species$species %in% g]),
         variables = unique(inst_species$variable[inst_species$species %in% g]))
  })
}, error = function(e) {
  message('Species tabs skipped: ', conditionMessage(e))
  list()
})

# A species by site: solid where most of the hour's atmosphere rows passed
# QAQC (their mean), dotted and faint where most failed (the mean of all
# rows, i.e. what the instrument read), so failing data stays visible. The
# y-axis is scaled to the passing data, so a flagged spike does not flatten it.
# key_sites: draw the tab's legend in this panel: each site in its color
# (clicking it hides that site's lines), then the line styles, solid for
# passing QAQC and dotted for failing. The keys are single points below the
# panel's y-axis range, there only for the legend.
inst_species_panel <- function(insts, var, key_sites = NULL) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  good_y <- c(); bad_y <- c()
  for (inst in insts) {
    pd <- data$instruments$obs[[inst]]
    if (!var %in% names(pd)) next
    attributes(pd$Time_UTC)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
    for (s in sort(unique(pd$stid))) {
      site <- pd[pd$stid == s, ]
      site <- site[order(site$Time_UTC), ]
      ok <- site[[paste0(var, '_ok')]]
      mostly_bad <- !is.na(ok) & ok < 0.5
      y_good <- ifelse(mostly_bad, NA, site[[var]])
      # the hour either side of a failing stretch joins the dots to the line
      near_bad <- mostly_bad | c(mostly_bad[-1], FALSE) | c(FALSE, head(mostly_bad, -1))
      y_bad <- ifelse(mostly_bad, site[[paste0(var, '_all')]],
                      ifelse(near_bad, site[[var]], NA))
      good_y <- c(good_y, y_good)
      bad_y <- c(bad_y, site[[paste0(var, '_all')]][mostly_bad])
      p <- add_trace(p, x = site$Time_UTC, y = y_good,
                     name = s, legendgroup = s, showlegend = F,
                     type = 'scattergl', mode = 'lines+markers',
                     line = list(color = site_colors[[s]]),
                     marker = list(color = site_colors[[s]], size = 4))
      if (any(mostly_bad)) {
        p <- add_trace(p, x = site$Time_UTC, y = y_bad,
                       name = paste(s, 'failing QAQC'), legendgroup = s,
                       showlegend = F, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
                       opacity = 0.6, connectgaps = F,
                       line = list(color = site_colors[[s]], dash = 'dot', width = 2))
      }
    }
  }
  good_y <- good_y[!is.na(good_y)]; bad_y <- bad_y[!is.na(bad_y)]
  yrange <- NULL
  if (length(good_y) + length(bad_y) == 0) {
    p <- add_annotations(p, text = 'no data', showarrow = F,
                         x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xref = 'paper', yref = 'paper',
                         font = list(color = '#999'))
  } else {
    # the passing data; the failing data's bulk (2nd to 98th percentile) only
    # when nothing passed
    r <- if (length(good_y) > 0) range(good_y) else quantile(bad_y, c(0.02, 0.98))
    yrange <- r + c(-0.05, 0.1) * max(diff(r), abs(r[2]) * 0.01, 1e-6)
  }
  if (!is.null(key_sites) && !is.null(yrange)) {
    t0 <- min(do.call(c, lapply(data$instruments$obs[insts], function(o) min(o$Time_UTC))))
    attributes(t0)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
    y_out <- yrange[1] - 10 * diff(yrange)
    key <- function(p, name, color, dash = 'solid', group = name) {
      add_trace(p, x = t0, y = y_out, name = name, legendgroup = group,
                type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines', showlegend = T, hoverinfo = 'skip',
                line = list(color = color, dash = dash, width = 2))
    }
    for (s in key_sites) p <- key(p, s, site_colors[[s]], group = s)
    p <- p %>%
      key('Passing QAQC', '#777') %>%
      key('Failing QAQC', '#777', dash = 'dot')
  }
  layout(p, xaxis = list(title = NA),
         yaxis = list(title = paste0(species_of(var), ' (', units_of(var), ')'),
                      range = yrange))
}

# Checks as one heatmap: one row per site and instrument, one column per
# hour, colored by its worst check that hour: how far the value sits from the
# middle of its allowed range (limits from QAQC_Flags.md). Pale green is
# mid-range, orange near a limit, red outside one. Hovering lists every check
# with its value and limits, the value red outside a limit and orange near one
# (outer 10% of the range).
# z is the distance from the middle of the range in % of the half-range, / 2:
# under 40 (well inside) pale green, 40-50 (outer 10% of the range, the same
# 'near a limit' as the hover) fading to orange, over 50 (outside) red
check_colorscale <- list(list(0, '#E3F2E1'), list(0.4, '#E3F2E1'),
                         list(0.4001, '#FCE3A6'), list(0.4999, '#FFB20F'),
                         list(0.5, '#ED254E'), list(1, '#ED254E'))
# The shortest folder under the same QAQC_Flags.md section, so lgr_ugga and
# lgr_ugga_manual_cal both read lgr_ugga
model_folder <- function(inst) {
  section <- inst_checks$name[match(inst, inst_checks$instrument)]
  folders <- unique(inst_checks$instrument[inst_checks$name == section])
  folders[which.min(nchar(folders))]
}
inst_checks_rows <- function(insts) {
  length(unique(unlist(lapply(insts, function(i) {
    paste(data$instruments$obs[[i]]$stid, i)
  }))))
}
inst_checks_panel <- function(insts) {
  hours <- seq(min(do.call(c, lapply(data$instruments$obs[insts], function(o) min(o$Time_UTC)))),
               max(do.call(c, lapply(data$instruments$obs[insts], function(o) max(o$Time_UTC)))),
               by = 3600)
  hour_text <- format(hours, tz = 'America/Denver', '%b %d %H:00')
  z <- list(); tips <- list(); labels <- c()
  rows <- unique(bind_rows(lapply(insts, function(i) {
    data.frame(stid = unique(data$instruments$obs[[i]]$stid), instrument = i)
  })))
  rows <- rows[order(rows$stid, rows$instrument), ]
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    s <- rows$stid[r]; inst <- rows$instrument[r]
    pd <- data$instruments$obs[[inst]]
    site <- pd[pd$stid == s, ]
    ck <- inst_checks %>%
      filter(instrument == inst, !is_species, variable %in% names(pd),
             !is.na(lo), !is.na(hi)) %>%
      distinct(variable, .keep_all = T)
    # Distance from the middle of the range, in % of the half-range:
    # 0 middle, 100 at a limit, over 100 outside
    off <- sapply(ck$variable, function(v) {
      x <- site[[v]][match(hours, site$Time_UTC)]
      i <- match(v, ck$variable)
      200 * abs(x - (ck$lo[i] + ck$hi[i]) / 2) / (ck$hi[i] - ck$lo[i])
    })
    off <- matrix(off, nrow = length(hours))
    worst <- apply(off, 1, function(o) if (all(is.na(o))) NA else max(o, na.rm = T))
    lines <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(ck)), function(i) {
      x <- site[[ck$variable[i]]][match(hours, site$Time_UTC)]
      # The value in the grid's colors: red outside a limit, orange near one
      value <- formatC(x, digits = 4, format = 'fg')
      value <- ifelse(is.na(off[, i]) | off[, i] <= 80, value,
                      sprintf('<b><span style="color:%s">%s</span></b>',
                              ifelse(off[, i] > 100, '#ED254E', '#FFB20F'), value))
      sprintf('%s %s <span style="color:#999">(limits %g to %g)</span>',
              ck$variable[i], value, ck$lo[i], ck$hi[i])
    })
    lines <- matrix(lines, nrow = length(hours))
    z <- c(z, list(pmin(worst, 200) / 2))  # 0-100, limit at 50
    tips <- c(tips, list(paste0('<b>', s, '</b> ', inst_short_name(inst), '<br>',
                                hour_text, '<br>',
                                apply(lines, 1, paste, collapse = '<br>'))))
    labels <- c(labels, sprintf('<span style="color:%s">●</span> %s %s',
                                site_colors[[s]], s, model_folder(inst)))
  }
  attributes(hours)$tzone <- 'America/Denver'
  plot_ly(x = hours, y = seq_along(labels), z = do.call(rbind, z),
          text = do.call(rbind, tips), hoverinfo = 'text',
          type = 'heatmap', zmin = 0, zmax = 100,
          colorscale = check_colorscale, showscale = F, ygap = 2,
          # a white box like the status grid's pop-up
          hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = 'white', bordercolor = '#ccc',
                            font = list(color = '#333', size = 12))) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = NA),
           yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'QAQC', font = list(size = 12)),
                        tickvals = seq_along(labels), ticktext = labels,
                        autorange = 'reversed', tickfont = list(size = 11)))
}

inst_tab_plot <- function(tab) {
  vars <- tab$variables[order(species_rank(species_of(tab$variables)))]
  sites <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(tab$instruments, function(i) data$instruments$obs[[i]]$stid))))
  species_panels <- lapply(seq_along(vars), function(i) {
    inst_species_panel(tab$instruments, vars[i], key_sites = if (i == 1) sites)
  })

  panels <- c(species_panels, list(inst_checks_panel(tab$instruments)))
  heights <- c(rep(2, length(vars)),
               max(0.5, 0.25 * inst_checks_rows(tab$instruments)))
  subplot(panels, nrows = length(panels), heights = heights / sum(heights),
          shareX = T, titleX = T, titleY = T) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = 'Mountain Time'), showlegend = T,
           legend = list(orientation = 'h', x = 0, y = 1.02, yanchor = 'bottom'))
}
```

```{r Species Tabs, results = 'asis'}
for (i in seq_along(inst_tabs)) {
```

### Log

```{r Log}
log_files <- dir('../../pipeline/log', full.names = T)
log_content <- sapply(log_files, function(file) {
  con <- pipe(paste('tail -n 1000', file), 'rb')
  content <- read_file(con)
  close(con)

  pattern <- 'Run: (\\w+)\\s\\|\\s(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2})(?:(?!Run:)[\\s\\S])+'
  runs <- as.data.frame(str_match_all(content, pattern))
  colnames(runs) <- c('content', 'stid', 'Time_UTC')

  run_content <- runs %>%
    slice_max(order_by = Time_UTC) %>%
    mutate(content = str_trim(content)) %>%
    pull(content)

  str_split(paste(run_content, collapse='\n\n'), '\n')[[1]]
})
names(log_content) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(names(log_content)))
print(log_content, quote = F)
```
